purpose: Apply the accepted historical source, original collection contract, terminal-history and semantic-independence gates to all six Campaign153 proposals before any value stage.

family_review.quoted_liquidity_cost: Economically independent, but no accepted local source supplies point-in-time bid and ask quotes; OHLC range is not a valid spread substitute.
family_review.aggressor_signed_order_flow: Economically independent only when side is directly observed. The accepted bars contain no aggressor side, while tick-rule inference reopens terminal return-sign and price-impact states.
family_review.transaction_count_and_mean_trade_size: Economically independent, but no accepted source supplies trade count or print identity. Amount divided by volume is transaction price, not average trade size.
family_review.order_cancellation_and_queue_replenishme: Economically independent, but requires event-time order add/cancel and displayed-quantity state absent from bar data.
family_review.capitalization_normalized_activity: Historical point-in-time capitalization/share counts remain outside the accepted contract; the formula is also a same-day turnover sibling already represented by signal_day_turnover_rate_pct.
family_review.limit_queue_persistence: Campaign115 is terminal by explicit continuing-scope decision, and daily OHLC cannot recover seal time, reopen count or queue amount. A board-rule price proxy is not an independent replacement.

proposal_gate_results.name: intraday_time_weighted_relative_quoted_spread_240m
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Best bid and best ask are absent from every accepted local historical contract; OHLC range substitution is forbidden.

proposal_gate_results.name: intraday_aggressor_signed_amount_imbalance_240m
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Provider-observed aggressor side is absent; price-tick side inference would be a terminal family proxy.

proposal_gate_results.name: intraday_mean_transaction_notional_240m
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Executed trade count and trade identity are absent from the accepted minute and daily schemas.

proposal_gate_results.name: intraday_queue_replenishment_after_cancellation_240m
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Order add/cancel event type, queue price and displayed quantity are absent from bar sources.

proposal_gate_results.name: daily_absolute_amount_to_free_float_market_cap_1d
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Point-in-time circ_mv is absent, current listing state cannot be projected backward, and the ratio reopens terminal turnover.

proposal_gate_results.name: daily_ohlc_inferred_limit_queue_persistence_1d
proposal_gate_results.terminal_reason: Point-in-time board/ST limit rules are absent and an OHLC proxy cannot reopen terminal Campaign115 queue or old limit-like price mechanisms.

next_action: Record all six Campaign153 concept decisions append-only, preserve the 157/142 orders, terminalize Campaign153 before values, and allow Campaign154 only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism backed by an already accepted point-in-time source or a separately authorized source-admission campaign.
